headline: Dow Cracks 53,000 As Amazon Joins The $3T Club And Oil Does The Heavy Lifting
summary: The Dow printed a fresh record above 53,000 as a sharp slide in crude oil handed the tape a broad rally and Amazon quietly became the second US company ever to cross the three-trillion-dollar market cap threshold.
